evaluation.decision: Retain the current native guard. Pure predicate generation remains bounded; a general Xtend compiler is outside scope.

genuine_typed_source_followup.scope: Parsed explicit and shorthand Function returns: literals, unary/binary/control operators, feature chains, index and invocation; real pinned library declarations. Validation, whole model comparison and persistence remain unqualified.
genuine_typed_source_followup.result_ownership: Nine explicit returns own their result. Three shorthand Function bodies create no owned return membership and reuse an inherited result owned by another Function; result construction and result selection must remain separate.
